name: RockyGrass
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.315

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: MeadowTurf grass (Grass004) with thin worn turf (leafy_grass) and stony ground (rocky_trail) breaking through in patches
known_weaknesses: stones are gravel-sized; the larger rocks of the original tiles must be meshes
